title: Supported Payment Network Types
segment100Applicability: Section 5 leaf labels are training-context classifications only. Cross-context compatibility with Prompt Code, card type, companion segments, lifecycle, and response requires separate source-backed mapping rules; that generic consistency requirement is REVIEW_REQUIRED.

businessRequirements.title: When a training artifact declares Section 5 network context, its classification shall use one of the 16 leaf types listed by ATL105.
Section 5 network classification shall agree with transaction, card, companion-segment, lifecycle, and response context.
businessRequirements.reviewReason: Section 5 enumerates supported types but does not define the claimed cross-context combinations. Add exact source-backed mapping rules before treating this as an enforceable BR.

businessRequirements.title: Classify ACH preauthorized debit cards as the ACH preauthorized-debit leaf under Section 5.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize ACH preauthorized debit cards as a supported Section 5 leaf. This classification alone does not assert a transaction-code or card-type mapping.

businessRequirements.title: Classify ATM PIN debit as a PIN debit subtype of ATM debit.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize PIN debit as a supported ATM-debit subtype. This classification alone does not assert a network brand or transaction-code mapping.

businessRequirements.title: Classify ATM PINless debit as a PINless debit subtype of ATM debit.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize PINless debit as a supported ATM-debit subtype. PINless eligibility rules are defined separately and are not inferred by this taxonomy BR.

businessRequirements.title: Classify check guarantee services as a supported Section 5 check leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish check guarantee services from check verification services. This classification alone does not assert a provider or processing rule.

businessRequirements.title: Classify BUYPASS-provided check verification as a distinct supported check leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish check verification provided by BUYPASS from guarantee services and verification provided by others.

businessRequirements.title: Classify check verification provided by others as a distinct supported check leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish check verification provided by others from BUYPASS-provided check verification. This label does not identify the external provider.

businessRequirements.title: Classify nonproprietary credit cards as a supported credit-card leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish nonproprietary credit cards from proprietary credit cards. Card-brand and Appendix E code mappings are separate requirements.

businessRequirements.title: Classify proprietary credit cards as a supported credit-card leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish proprietary credit cards from nonproprietary credit cards. Do not infer a specific proprietary program or card code from this label.

businessRequirements.title: Classify EBT food-stamp benefits as a supported EBT leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish food-stamp benefits from EBT cash benefits and eWIC. Detailed EBT rules remain separately applicable.

businessRequirements.title: Classify EBT cash benefits as a supported EBT leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish cash benefits from food-stamp benefits and eWIC. Detailed EBT rules remain separately applicable.

businessRequirements.title: Classify eWIC as a distinct supported EBT leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall distinguish eWIC from food-stamp and cash benefits. eWIC transaction behavior is governed by its dedicated ATL105 rules, not by this classification BR.

businessRequirements.title: Classify proprietary cards as a supported Section 5 leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize proprietary cards as a supported category distinct from the separately listed petroleum proprietary and fleet categories. Do not infer that the source categories are mutually exclusive beyond their listing.

businessRequirements.title: Classify petroleum proprietary cards as a supported Section 5 leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize petroleum proprietary cards as the separately listed Section 5 category. This classification alone does not assert a fuel transaction or card-code mapping.

businessRequirements.title: Classify fleet cards as a supported Section 5 leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize fleet cards as a supported Section 5 category. Fleet-specific field and companion-segment rules remain separately applicable.

businessRequirements.title: Classify stored value cards as a supported Section 5 leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize stored value cards as a supported Section 5 category. Stored-value operation and lifecycle rules remain separately applicable.

businessRequirements.title: Classify loyalty cards as a supported Section 5 leaf.
businessRequirements.requirement: The training classifier shall recognize loyalty cards as a supported Section 5 category. Loyalty operation and response rules remain separately applicable.

validationStatus: Independent oracle recognizes all 16 Section 5 labels. These BRs train taxonomy classification only; per-leaf transaction/card compatibility and AI artifact coverage remain pending.
